title: CFD / Stimulation Engineer
description:
About NoPo NoPo Nanotechnologies is India's only commercial manufacturer of Single Walled Carbon Nanotubes (SWCNTs), produced through our proprietary HiPCO (High Pressure Carbon Monoxide) process. We are a fast growing, technically driven organization working at the frontier of advanced materials manufacturing, with applications spanning energy, composites, and next generation industrial technologies. Key Responsibilities A. CFD Modelling and Simulation Develop and execute CFD models for tubular reactors, multi-tubular reactors, gas flow systems, and high-temperature process equipment used in SWCNT production. Simulate fluid flow, Reynolds number / turbulence, temperature distribution, heat transfer, pressure drop, and gas residence time under different operating conditions. Select appropriate turbulence models, discretization schemes, boundary conditions, and numerical solution methods based on the physics of the process. Conduct mesh generation, mesh independence studies, convergence assessment, and numerical sensitivity analysis. B. Reactor Design and Thermal Analysis Analyse temperature uniformity, hot spots, cold zones, and thermal gradients within reactors and associated heating systems. Evaluate heat transfer between heating elements, reactor walls, and process gases. Investigate the impact of reactor geometry, tube arrangement, heating configuration, insulation, and operating conditions on thermal performance. C. SWCNT Process and Reactor Optimization and troubleshooting Model gas flow and residence time for CO-based SWCNT production processes, including HiPco or other relevant processes, as applicable to the company's technology. Evaluate gas distribution, mixing, recirculation, flow maldistribution, and pressure drop across reactor assemblies. Support the modelling of gas-phase reactions, species transport, and reaction kinetics where suitable kinetic data are available. Assess the effect of operating parameters on process stability, gas utilization, thermal efficiency, and potential reactor fouling. Collaborate with experimental teams to develop modelling approaches for complex R&D problems. D. Validation, Troubleshooting, and Continuous Improvement Validate CFD predictions against experimental measurements, pilot plant data, temperature profiles, pressure measurements, and flow data. Investigate deviations between simulated and actual reactor performance and recommend corrective actions. Conduct parametric studies, sensitivity analysis, and design-of-experiments-based simulation studies. Provide engineering recommendations to resolve flow maldistribution, overheating, inadequate heat transfer, and pressure-drop issues. Support root cause analysis of reactor performance and equipment-related problems. 
 Required Qualifications Bachelor's degree in Mechanical Engineering, Chemical Engineering, Aerospace Engineering, or a closely related engineering discipline. 3 to 5 years of hands-on experience in CFD modelling and simulation for industrial equipment, reactors, thermal systems, or chemical processes. Proficiency in at least one major CFD platform, such as ANSYS Fluent, ANSYS CFX, or OpenFOAM. Strong understanding of fluid mechanics, heat transfer, thermodynamics, and numerical methods. Practical experience with turbulence modelling, mesh generation, mesh quality assessment, convergence monitoring, and mesh independence studies. Working knowledge of energy equations, species transport, pressure-drop calculations, and residence-time analysis. Ability to define appropriate boundary conditions and material properties and critically assess simulation assumptions. Experience in interpreting CFD results and translating them into practical engineering recommendations. Strong analytical, problem-solving, technical documentation, and communication skills. Preferred Skills Experience in CFD simulation of chemical reactors, tubular reactors, multi-tubular reactors, or high-temperature gas-phase processes. Exposure to carbon nanotube synthesis, CVD, HiPco, gas-phase nanomaterial synthesis, or related advanced-materials processes. Experience with conjugate heat transfer (CHT), radiation modelling, and high-temperature thermal systems. Understanding of reacting-flow models, finite-rate chemistry, species transport, and chemical kinetics. Exposure to particle tracking, aerosol dynamics, nucleation, deposition, or population balance modelling. Experience in modelling electrical heating systems, heated reactor assemblies, refractory insulation, and thermal losses. Knowledge of statistical analysis, design of experiments (DoE), and correlation of simulation results with experimental data. Experience supporting pilot-scale equipment design, process troubleshooting, and technology scale-up. Why Join Us Be part of India's only commercial SWCNT manufacturer, working at the cutting edge of nanotechnology and advanced materials Gain hands on experience with specialized, high value manufacturing equipment not found in conventional industries Work in a growing organization backed by leading venture investors, with clear opportunities for skill development and career growth Collaborative work culture with exposure to production, quality, and R&D teams Contribute to technology with applications ranging from energy storage to advanced aerospace materials.

Key Skills: CFD,Dynamics,CFD Analysis,Thermal,Analysis,Fluid,Fluent,Heat transfer

title: Sr. Engineer Quality ( Female only- Lighting Plant)
description:
JOB DESCRIPTION Role Title Sr. Engineer Quality - Plant 
 1. JOB PURPOSE 
 Responsible for ensuring that products and processes meet established quality standards by identifying Gaps, implementing timely corrective measures, and ensuring quality control systems throughout the raw material inward stage, in-process stages, assembly and final product quality check stage so as to reduce IHR and Customer PPM. 
 2. PRINCIPAL ACCOUNTABILITIES (Accountabilities associated with the job) Quality Control & Improvement: Conduct RCA of recurring issues (internal/external customer), analyze & implement timely CAPA for fixing gaps to ensure no repeated issues. Ensure action plans from audits are implemented to close all the non-conformities. Ensure all laid out procedures and tests and QMS documentation are implemented as per VQS. Develop the Incoming Quality check plan with respect to sampling plan and at par with Customer specific requirements (for Raw materials, BOP etc.) Conduct rating process for suppliers on quality parameters & functional/fitment checking of parts to be dispatched. Ensure parts to be dispatched by plant are checked for rust, dust, dent, damage, mechanical parameters etc. and conduct final visual inspection. Prepare various reports (Audit, CAPA, Complaints etc.) independently. Analyze process to find improvements, analyse the root cause of any problem that occurred with CFT, and identify any non-value-added activities Choose statistical technique with optimum amount of data required to ensure adequate resources and due dates are met for test report writing, with supervision Quality Assurance: Communicate the importance of the implementation of QMS procedures to all units. Cascade the concerned procedures to the respective process owners (Engineering, Production, PPC, Logistics, etc.) Design, implement and document procedures for process control, process improvement, testing and inspection, with limited supervision. Define metrics for measuring performance on quality parameters in units. Develop procedures for end-to-end quality assurance from sample collection, analysis to disposal Conduct audits of manufacturing process parameters, Product & System and ensure deviations are corrected Recognize causes and consequences of quality issues that are not readily apparent while doing cause analysis. Identify gaps in information and predict/gather relevant data in order to continue analysis and/or initiate suitable corrective action Use GD8 principles / Customer Specific formats to solve issues in the plant related to Quality of process and Product. Ensure Lesson Learnt, PTDB for all the failure in-house & customer are updated timely to Design team for future reference to ensure No re-occurrence of issues. Quality Systems Application: Understand customer quality requirements (process and product characteristics) Be active member in CFT for development of Process documents during the Product Planning process (Gate 0) and all steps of DFMEA Participate as CFT member to Calculate the SOD (Severity x Occurrence x Detection) number or risk priority number (RPN) as part of PFMEA Develop robust Control Plans ensuring effective SOPs and WI (Work Instructions) at par with PFMEA.
